Setting up or expanding a plant? Under the Project Imports Regulations, all the machinery, components and spares for an eligible project can be registered with Customs and cleared under heading 9801 at a single rate of duty, instead of classifying each item separately. We handle the registration, track every consignment against the contract and finalise the project at the end. EPCG authorisations for capital goods are also covered.

What counts as ODC or over-dimensional cargo?
Anything too wide, too high, too long or too heavy for a standard container or a normal truck. On Indian roads that usually means special permits and escorts. We assess each piece individually.
Who is eligible for project imports under 9801?

Imports for setting up or substantially expanding eligible industrial projects, such as power, industrial plants and certain infrastructure. The project must be registered with Customs before clearance. We check eligibility with you first.
Can you move machinery from a closed factory abroad?
Yes. Our partners abroad handle dismantling and crating at origin, and we run the export, the sea move and the project-import clearance in India as one job.
How early should we contact you?
As early as possible, ideally while the purchase is still being negotiated. Route surveys and registrations take time, and the Incoterm you agree with the seller affects the whole plan.
